:::{#def-exponential-function}
#### Exponential function

The **exponential function** $\exp : \reals \to (0, \infty)$ is

$$\expf{x} \eqdef \lim_{n \to \infty} \paren{1 + \frac{x}{n}}^n,$$

the [limit](#def-sequence-limit) of the [sequence](sets-functions.qmd#def-sequence)
$\paren{1 + \frac{x}{1}}^1, \paren{1 + \frac{x}{2}}^2, \paren{1 + \frac{x}{3}}^3, \ldots$.
That limit exists for every real number $x$, and it is positive.

:::
